launch.note: No launch date is announced. When one is set it appears here first.

rehearsal.note: The devnet rehearsal coin ran at 1% per $1B (the mainnet rule is 2%); its two executed burns are real devnet transactions anyone can check.

firstBurnPath.line: Nothing burns until the curve fills and the debt rises: $DEFICIT must graduate at 85 SOL raised and have its pool registered and verified before a Treasury reading with at least one full $1B unit can start a burn.

demo.summary: Treasury's Debt to the Penny rose $23.92B from 2026-10-05 to 2026-10-06: 23 units. The rule asked for 0.104 SOL of the 0.506 SOL burn pool; one crank may spend at most 2% of the trading pool's SOL reserve, so 0.0201 SOL bought 4,010,874.87 $DEFICIT and every token bought was burned in the same transaction; the rest carried to the next crank.

design: Rules are locked at launch; a different rule is a different coin.
Pairs: winner takes the burn — fees from both coins burn the winner's supply (devnet; flag off on mainnet).
Every rule end that resolves forwards the leftover burn pool to a sink (the contest's winner, else $DEFICIT): designed, not built.
Upgrade authority: the Squads 2-of-3 vault, then set to none as the last step (not done).
